decisions.reason: As a large German metal-products firm with strong door-system know-how, the company can learn quickly in garage door operators and the dedicated web page signals meaningful commitment despite the electronics being somewhat outside its core.

A solid wood sectional garage door is less aligned with the firm's core metal-processing knowledge and, with only limited website prominence, offers weaker absorptive-capacity advantages for improvement and scale-up.

This remote-control operator is adjacent to the firm's door business but overlaps strongly with Product A, and the lower website emphasis suggests it may be rationalised if early results do not justify a separate line.

Although a glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's core capabilities well, the weaker website presence and apparent overlap with the more prominently presented Product F make it a plausible candidate for portfolio consolidation.
An insulated glazed industrial sectional door builds directly on the firm's established industrial-door knowledge and should benefit from strong in-house learning and incremental refinement.
This product is highly consistent with the firm's existing metal door competencies and its own webpage indicates a strong commercial commitment and good prospects for further development.
